title: North Korea Warns South Korea Not to Cross Border by Even a Millimeter
detail: North Korea issued a stark warning to South Korea not to cross the inter-Korean border by even a millimeter, signaling heightened inter-Korean tensions. The warning comes amid ongoing pressure from Seoul over the DMZ landmine blast and reflects Pyongyang's increasingly assertive posture toward the South.

media.caption: North Korea warns South Korea not to cross the border
